initial_observation.signalrgb_logs: Repeated acquisition timeouts; earlier H6008 missing-service errors persisted despite uncached discovery.

reproduced_bugs: Renewed lease while a cancelled operation unwinds can permanently stop its device worker.
External worker cancellation can lose the child reference before draining it.

recovery_policy.fatal_action: Orderly companion exit; the existing Windows supervisor restarts the process.

limits: The races are deterministically reproduced, but suspended task stacks from the original process were not recovered; their role in every preceding Bluetooth error is not established.
This short live observation does not establish hours-long Bluetooth stability.
An event loop or kernel operation that cannot respond to cancellation is outside the guaranteed recovery scope.
Only the Govee companion was reloaded. No SignalRGB/Windows restart, adapter reset, forced power-on or firmware change was performed.
